limitations: Diagnostic snapshot never authenticates signatures/current issuer or authorizes a gate; trusted fixture caller, not an operator access API
DB event records are not commit timestamps or exact source-fence/traffic-effect instants
Between-effect time includes measurement/signing/storage/authority/lease work; no individual probe duration is inferred
Client elapsed is monotonic; never subtracted from DB UTC timestamps
Read-only export runs after measured handoff; collector revisions do not constitute a workload performance optimization
Separate closed-loop runs have different arrival timing and host conditions; no statistical SLO or causal improvement claim
Same local arm64 node and PG17.12 server with separate databases, synthetic plan/IdP/bootstrap and local witness, not AWS-to-independent-onprem operations
Prior clock/data/capacity/timeout/exhaustion failures retained; a later successful run does not establish their cause or erase them
